title: Local Library
author: atlas-demo
text:
# Local Library

Local Library saves Markdown sources on disk.
It uses Python and SQLite.

## Use

Run `library save <url>` to save a source.
Run `library check` to compare file hashes.
Notes stay separate from source titles.
Images stay beside their source files.
Repeat links increase a seen count.
The tool needs no paid service.
The MIT licence permits reuse.
summary:
Local Library saves sources on disk.
It stores source text as Markdown.
It uses Python.
It stores rows in SQLite.
The save command accepts a URL.
The check command compares file hashes.
Notes stay separate from titles.
Images stay beside source files.
Repeat links increase the seen count.
The tool needs no paid service and uses the MIT licence.
